messages:
Priya (Product Ops): quick follow-up from the all-hands  leadership: who exactly are our primary target customers for the next 12 months? want a short list to align onboarding flows.

Anna (CEO): Primary targets: 1) AI-native startups (fast time-to-value), 2) Platform teams at mid-market SaaS (standardize inference), 3) Regulated product teams needing Private deployments. Keep messaging crisp for each.

Sasha (Head of GTM): For GTM: call out finance + infra buyers for cost predictability, and product leads for speed-to-launch. Different hooks.

Theo (Head of Strategy): Competitive note: expect commodity LLM APIs to lower attention. Our angle: make their operational cost predictable and migration easy.

Jamal (Eng Lead): Practically, that means features: explicit cost controls, per-route p95 guarantees (where possible), and a clear migration doc. We'll add these to infra backlog.

Priya (Product Ops): can we get a 3-line elevator pitch per segment? I'll add to onboarding.

Anna (CEO): I'll draft 🙂: - Startups: "Ship LLM features fast with predictable cost"; - Platform teams: "Unified runtime, consistent SLAs across environments"; - Regulated teams: "Private deployments with audit & KMS". Use as starting point.

Sasha (Head of GTM): Also prep an FAQ for competitive objections: "why not cheaper tokens elsewhere" -> show end-to-end cost + latency + fallback story.

Theo (Head of Strategy): I'll prep short competitor rebuttals and share in #gtm-playbooks by EOD.

deploy-bot: archived per policy.

Anna (CEO): thanks all, please review the drafts when posted.
